stem.timeline.popup_blocked: Idirishya ry'Umurongo w'Igihe ryahagaritswe. Emerera amadirishya yisohoka kuri uru rupapuro, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
stem.timeline.opened_sr: Timeline Studio yafunguwe mu idirishya rishya.
stem.timeline.thinking: ✨ Ndimo gusoma inyandiko no gushakisha ibyabaye bifite amatariki…
stem.timeline.needtext: Komeka byibuze igika gito cy'inyandiko kirimo amatariki amwe.
stem.timeline.noevents: Nta byabaye bifite amatariki asobanutse byabonetse muri iyo nyandiko. Gerageza igice kirimo imyaka cyangwa amatariki.
stem.timeline.needsai: Inama za AI zizimye, bityo igikoresho cyo kwiyubakira umurongo w'igihe kizafunguka — ongeraho ibyabaye wenyine.
stem.timeline.blocked: Idirishya ryisohoka ryahagaritswe — emerera amadirishya yisohoka kuri uru rupapuro hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
stem.timeline.ready: Umurongo w'igihe ufunguye mu idirishya rishya. Reka iri dirishya rifunguye kugira ngo ushobore kuwoherereza indi mirongo y'igihe.
stem.timeline.error: Hari ikitagenze neza mu gukora umurongo w'igihe:
stem.timeline.title: 🕰️ Timeline Studio — hindura isomo umurongo w'igihe
stem.timeline.blurb: Komeka isomo — urupapuro rw'amateka, amateka y'ubuzima, cyangwa inkuru y'ubuvumbuzi bwa siyansi — maze AI ibone ibyabaye bifite amatariki ibishyire mu murongo w'igihe ushobora kunyuramo intambwe ku yindi. Ni byiza cyane mu guhindura inyandiko yuzuye urukurikirane rusobanutse.
stem.timeline.source_label: Komeka inyandiko igomba guhinduka umurongo w'igihe
stem.timeline.placeholder: Komeka igice kirimo amatariki — urugero umutwe uvuga ku marushanwa yo mu kirere, amateka y'ubuzima bw'umuhanga, ibyabaye mu gitabo…
stem.timeline.generate_title: Kora umurongo w'igihe ushobora gukoreshwa uhereye ku nyandiko yakomekwe
stem.timeline.build_title: Fungura idirishya ry'umurongo w'igihe kugira ngo wiyubakire
stem.timeline.ai_on: AI irakora — isoma inyandiko yawe ikavanamo ibyabaye bifite amatariki.
stem.timeline.ai_off: Inama za AI zizimye — koresha «Wiyubakire» kugira ngo wongereho ibyabaye wenyine mu idirishya ry'umurongo w'igihe.
stem.timeline.privacy: Inyandiko yawe n'umurongo w'igihe bisigara mu bwenge bw'imashini gusa — nta kibikwa cyangwa ngo gitangwe amanota.
stem.timeline.credit: Iyerekanwa ry'umurongo w'igihe: TimelineJS ya Knight Lab ya Northwestern University (timeline.knightlab.com), ku buntu kandi isoko rifunguye munsi ya Mozilla Public License. Isomero ripakururwa kuri CDN ya Knight Lab, bityo iki gikoresho gikeneye interineti.
